run_inference: run inference on a single benchmark system with a checkpoint and optional warmup and timed iterations
compare_results: compare candidate inference predictions against a baseline result and compute energy force and stress error metrics
format_report_table: format benchmark results dictionary as a human-readable table string with energy error force MAE and QPS columns
PerfCheckRunner_run: run a full benchmark comparing candidate inference settings against an fp64 baseline across default test systems
PerfCheckRunner_init: initialize a PerfCheckRunner with a checkpoint device warmup and timed iteration counts and inference settings
